description: Audit test vectors for diBoaS /tools suite. Each scenario has explicit input, expectedOutput, and per-field tolerance. Auditor implementations should match expectedOutput within the tolerance. v3 (2026-05-26): FX-16 adoption D1+D8 — EUR `annualDepreciation` 1.23% → 0.55% (D1 field-placement fix per Bar 2026-05-26 decision register); EUR-bearing scenarios regenerated from live engine post-update; PT3' €541,891 supersedes prior PT3 €608,815; 14 new currencies added to `exchangeRates.rates`. Schema bump prevents auditors from comparing new code against stale v2 vectors. v2 (2026-05-23): F6 — assetHistory mode-comparison scenario uses explicit `lumpSumAmount` + `dcaAmount` input fields. v4 (2026-11-11, post-merge audit; founder answer 8 asked for a CI comparison of every reference result): the vectors are now compared in CI by gate TOOLS-VEC-1 (toolsReferenceVectors.test.ts). Re-baselined where the harness, which computes with the product's rates, no longer matched: assetHistory pinned to end month 2026-10-01 (each vector carries endYm; values had moved with every monthly append and with corrections to past months such as the May 2026 Bitcoin close, #813), and the inflationImpact invested values at the conservative 7% (founder F-6 ruling 2026-07-11; the vectors still grew at 10%). Fields changed: {"assetHistory":95,"inflationImpact":8}.

PT1.note: pt-BR Retirement Bar-signed acceptance (2026-05-23) No market-data dependency (scenario constants only), so no end month applies.

PT2.note: SP500 2010 DCA total_return vs price_only delta. Updated 2026-05-23 v1.2 from 18.76 → 18.33 after F1 dedup (Auditor 4 N1). Still within Bar-signed ±2pp envelope. Pinned 2026-11-10 to end month 2026-10 (5.853): 19.13 there, inside the signed ±2pp envelope; the signed 18.33 predates the 2026-11 total-return corrections (5.633), so no month reproduces it exactly.

PT3.note: PT3' Bar-signed re-acceptance 2026-05-26 (FX-16 adoption D1+D2). Retired prior PT3 €608,815 which reflected the now-corrected EUR field-placement error (annualDepreciation was carrying a retrospective endpoint-pair CAGR 1.23% misplaced in the forward field; now carries the locked forward calibration assumption 0.55%). No market-data dependency (scenario constants only), so no end month applies.

PA1.gate: BRL yearly rate shown on the currency card, from its anchor pair (Jan 2010 → 22 May 2026)
PA1.note: Re-signed 2026-11-10 at the computed value (founder, DR-2026-11-10 answer 7; 5.854): the card computes its yearly rate from the two rates it shows, 1.874 → 5.0134 BRL per USD over the anchor dates 2010-01-01 → 2026-05-22, = 6.19%. Was 0.0621, the full-series BCB PTAX CAGR (192 monthly observations), which is still the forward fallback `annualDepreciation` in constants.ts, a separate calibration field no longer signed by PA1. Tolerance ±0.5 percentage points (0.005 as a decimal) unchanged.

BTC_RECON.note: Phase A BTC reconciliation. Updated 2026-05-23 from $254,188 → $261,202 after F1 dedup fix (Yahoo partial-trailing-bar duplicates removed; at the time the May 2026 close read $77,539, later corrected to $73,579.69 by #813, so 261,202 is reproducible at no end month today). Jan-2016 start per v1.1 UX spec. Product-owner (Bar) re-ack pending for the updated point estimate; within originally-accepted $200k–$280k research-anchored envelope. Re-signed by the founder 2026-11-10 at 261,403, pinned to end month 2026-10 (DR-2026-11-10-market-open-decisions answer 8; 5.853): the gate had no end month, so every monthly append moved it (signed 261,202 before).
